supporting_pages.title: "Configure Datastore indexes with index.yaml \_|\_ App Engine standard environment\
evidence_snippets: The kind of the entity for the query. properties A list of properties to include as columns of the index, in the order to be sorted: properties used in equality filters first, followed by the property used in inequality filters, then the sort orders and their directions.
Each element in this list has the following elements: name The datastore name of the property. direction The direction to sort, either asc for ascending or desc for descending.
Each element in the list represents an index for the application.
